{{Top|leg}}
'''Niriktavi coral''' was a type of [[Coral/Legends|coral]] that could be found in [[Niriktavi Bay]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taratos IV]]. The [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Bant'ena Fhernan]] suspected that the coral possessed antibacterial properties and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she led a research team to Taratos IV to study the Niriktavi coral.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>
